BiblicalUsage: James uses this word once to name the wisdom that does not come from above: earthly, sensual, devilish. It is wisdom that looks clever and serves the devil's ends.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse gives us a test for every clever idea: if it breeds envy and strife, it is not from God, whatever it calls itself.
